links.outcome: CDE-level sensitivity of P-WIN versus existing PICU Warning Tool and huddle workflow
links.effect: P-WIN detected 73% of CDEs 1-24 hours in advance vs PICU Warning Tool 39% (P<.05) and huddle workflow 23% (P<.05); PPV similar.
links.quote: P-WIN detected 73% of these CDE 1-24 hours in advance, outperforming the PICU Warning Tool (39%, P < .05) and huddle workflow (23%, P < .05).

links.outcome: Prospective real-time performance of predictive model in live PICU data
links.effect: Prospective evaluation in live EHR data over Jan 7-Apr 7, 2026: 73% of CDEs detected in advance, 0.21 alerts per patient-day.
links.quote: We prospectively evaluated the performance, operational utility, and deployment feasibility of the PICU Warning Index (P-WIN), a personalized ML alert system predicting CDE in the PICU.

screen.reason: Prospective real-time clinical deployment evaluating an EHR-integrated ML deterioration alert system (P-WIN) in a pediatric ICU compared to baseline tools.
